mapper.select: SELECT wl.*, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS user_name, b.title AS book_title FROM waiting_list wl LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = wl.user_id LEFT JOIN book b ON b.book_id = wl.book_id WHERE wl.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY wl.join_date DESC

SELECT wl.wait_id as waitId, wl.user_id as userId, wl.book_id as bookId, wl.join_date as joinDate, b.title as bookTitle, b.quantity, b.held_quantity as heldQuantity, b.available,
(SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM waiting_list wl2 WHERE wl2.book_id = wl.book_id AND wl2.status = 'WAITING' AND (wl2.join_date < wl.join_date OR (wl2.join_date = wl.join_date AND wl2.wait_id < wl.wait_id))) as position,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM waiting_list wl3 WHERE wl3.book_id = wl.book_id AND wl3.status = 'WAITING') as totalWaiting,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM waiting_list wl4 WHERE wl4.book_id = wl.book_id AND wl4.status = 'NOTIFIED') as notifiedCount FROM waiting_list wl JOIN book b ON wl.book_id = b.book_id WHERE wl.user_id = #{userId} AND wl.status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY wl.join_date ASC
